profile:
# Amy Klobuchar Watchdog File

Subject: Amy Klobuchar, Democrat, MN, running for Governor in 2026
Current office: U.S. Senate MN
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
Status: queued for hand research, priority 1. This file holds the roster facts, the office levers, and FEC pipeline data when the pipeline has run. It is not yet a finished Tier 2 profile.

## Race

Race status: nominee. Rating: Cook: Solid D. Current holder of the seat: Tim Walz.
Opponents: Lisa Demuth, Republican.
Roster note: Senate term runs to 2031; win would open an appointment

## Committee assignments

- Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry (Ranking Member)
- Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation
- Senate Committee on Rules and Administration
- Senate Committee on the Judiciary
- Joint Committee of Congress on the Library
- Joint Economic Committee

## Money

Not yet pulled. Run pipeline/fec_pull.py for federal subjects. Governors and other state candidates need hand research in the state campaign finance system.

## Levers this office controls

Template rows from the office and committee assignments. Each needs the specific decision, the date, and the subject position before it counts as a finding.

| Decision | Where it sits | Which blocs care |
|---|---|---|
| Public utility commission appointments and rate case posture | Governor | Utilities and energy; Utilities and data centers |
| Gaming regulator appointments and tribal compact negotiation | Governor | Gambling |
| State budget, line item veto and bill signing or veto | Governor | Every bloc |
| Agency head appointments and major state contracts, including Medicaid managed care | Governor | Health care and pharma; Detention vendors; Developers and construction |
| University and school board appointments, voucher and school choice program funding | Governor | School choice and family |
| Insurance commissioner or regulator appointment and tort law bills | Governor | Insurance and tort |
| Emergency declarations and no bid emergency procurement | Governor | Detention vendors; Developers and construction |
| Judicial appointments where the governor appoints | Governor | Insurance and tort; Ideological groups |
| Data center incentives, permitting and power siting | Governor | Utilities and data centers; AI industry; Tech |
| Clemency, pardons and suspension powers | Governor | Enforcement and disclosure |
| Farm bill, sugar program, crop insurance, CFTC jurisdiction over prediction markets and crypto commodities | Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry (Ranking Member) | Sugar and agriculture; Crypto and finance; Gambling |
| AI preemption, spectrum, aviation, transportation safety, consumer protection, FTC and FCC nominations | Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation | AI industry; Tech; Crypto and finance |
| Which bills reach the floor and under what terms | Senate Committee on Rules and Administration | Party and leadership |
| Federal election law, FEC nominations, campaign finance rules | Senate Committee on Rules and Administration | Enforcement and disclosure; Party and leadership |
| Antitrust, immigration enforcement, judicial nominations, tort and liability law, online platform rules | Senate Committee on the Judiciary | Tech; Detention vendors; Insurance and tort; AI industry |
